[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec loop (ops: List Int) (i: Nat) (balance: Int) (result: Bool) : Bool :=
  match ops with
  | [] => result
  | head :: tail =>
    let balance' := balance + head
    let result' := if balance' < 0 then true else result
    loop tail (i + 1) balance' result'
loop operations 0 0 false
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation operations
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  -- proof of spec
  by_cases h_result: result
  -- case when result is true
  simp [h_result]
  simp [below_zero_condition]
  obtain ⟨i, hi, h_sum_neg⟩ := below_zero_condition
  use i
  linarith
  -- case when result is false
  simp [h_result]
  by_contra
  rename_i h_result_false
  simp at h_result_false
  exact h_result_false
[END]
